scope.scope_source: Fixed export protocol for the saved job-28965 records; chain/frame counts are checked against the source summary.
scope.importance_ess_denominator: 4096 candidate paths including initialization and burn-in
scope.comparison_note: Pointwise descriptive 3-SEM screen; not an equivalence test, multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis test or mixing proof.
scope.uncertainty_note: Conditional on four finite chains; excludes training-seed variation and cannot exclude unobserved long dependence.
